title: GPT Image 2: Free AI Image Generator & Editor Online
excerpt: Create and edit AI images online with GPT Image 2. Turn text prompts and reference images into 1K, 2K, or 4K visuals. Sign in to try it free.
content_html:
GPT Image 2Create & Edit AI Images Online

GPT Image 2 is an AI image generator and editor for turning text prompts and reference images into campaign visuals, product concepts, social content, and more. Start with a description or upload an image, then generate and review the result with 1K, 2K, and 4K output options.

Quality

Ratio

Images

Format

Image2 Prompt Examples

Browse selected prompt cases from the same library. Click any card to open the shared prompt modal.

Prompt workflow

A clearer path from idea to image

Give the model a clear brief, choose the right output settings, and refine the result in small steps.

01

Describe the subject

Start with the main subject, then add the setting, action, mood, and any details that should stay visible.

02

Choose the output

Use ratio, quality, image count, and format to match the way you plan to use the image.

03

Review and refine

Generate a draft, inspect the details, and adjust the prompt when the composition needs another pass.

Prompt detail that helps

For posters, signs, and interface mockups, put the exact words in quotation marks and describe where they should appear.

What you can control

Tools for practical image work

ImageAICraft keeps the important controls close to the prompt, so you can move from a rough direction to a usable visual without changing tools.

Text-led layouts

Describe labels, headlines, signs, and interface copy directly in the prompt.

Flexible visual styles

Move between photography, illustration, editorial, anime, and other visual directions.

Image-to-image editing

Upload reference images and explain what to preserve, replace, remove, or restyle.

Multiple aspect ratios

Prepare square, wide, and portrait compositions for different placements.

Flexible exports

Choose JPEG, PNG, or WebP based on the destination and the next step in your workflow.

A practical workflow

Built for iteration

A useful image workflow rarely ends with the first result. Start with a clear direction, compare the output with your intent, and make focused changes instead of rewriting everything from scratch.

ImageAICraft brings prompting, image-to-image editing, quality choices, and export formats into one compact workspace for repeatable creative work.

  • Text-to-image and image-to-image modes
  • 1K, 2K, and 4K quality choices
  • Square, wide, and portrait ratios
  • JPEG, PNG, and WebP exports

1K–4Kquality choices

Use cases

A fit for everyday creative work

Use the same workspace for early concepts, campaign assets, product visuals, and image edits.

Digital Marketing

Make ad creatives and social visuals with clean calls to action.

E-Commerce Catalogs

Turn product ideas into polished lifestyle imagery and packaging mockups.

Brand Identity

Draft logo directions, palette studies, and brand systems quickly.

EdTech & Presentations

Create diagrams and slide visuals with legible labels and sharper clarity.

UI/UX Prototyping

Sketch realistic product screens before a full implementation cycle begins.

Workflow scenarios

One workspace, different jobs

Campaign concepts

Explore poster directions, social visuals, and headline-led compositions before production.

Product visuals

Test packaging ideas, product scenes, and lifestyle directions with a consistent prompt workflow.

Interface studies

Sketch UI directions, mockups, diagrams, and presentation visuals before committing to a build.

Image revisions

Use reference images and targeted instructions to try new backgrounds, styles, or visual treatments.

FAQ

What is GPT Image 2?

ImageAICraft is an independent web app built around GPT Image 2 for text-to-image generation and image-to-image editing. Turn natural-language prompts and reference images into polished visuals in one focused workspace.

How do I start?

Sign in, enter a prompt or switch to Image to image and upload a reference image, choose your ratio, quality, and format, then click Generate. You can refine the result with another prompt.

Is there a free trial?

Yes. Sign in to try the standard 1K generation workflow with free trial access. You do not need a paid plan to test the basic experience; paid plans provide more credits and higher-capacity workflows.

Do I need design skills?

No. Describe the subject, style, layout, or changes you want in plain language. You can also use prompt examples for ideas and guidance.

How are credits used?

Credit usage depends on the selected output resolution and image count: 1K uses 1 credit per image, 2K uses 6 credits per image, and 4K uses 8 credits per image. Batch generation adds the per-image cost for each output.

What quality, ratios, and formats are available?

The workspace offers 1K, 2K, and 4K quality choices, square, landscape, portrait, and wide aspect ratios, plus JPEG, PNG, and WebP exports.

Can I edit an existing image?

Yes. Switch to Image to image, upload one or more supported JPG, PNG, or WebP reference images, and describe what you want to preserve, replace, remove, or restyle.

Can I use generated images commercially?

Paid plans are designed for commercial creative workflows such as marketing, product concepts, and content production. Commercial use is subject to our Terms of Service, and you are responsible for reviewing copyright, trademark, likeness, privacy, and other third-party rights.

Is my data private?

We use prompts, settings, uploaded images, and generated results to fulfill your requests through the service and its providers. We do not use your content to train our own AI models or publicly display private user content unless you choose to share it or give permission.

Can GPT Image 2 render text in images accurately?

GPT Image 2 can create readable text for posters, signs, labels, product mockups, and other visual layouts. Always review the final output carefully, especially when the image includes important names, numbers, or branded wording.

Get started
